ios.desc:
Meet your new favourite way to browse Hacker News (HN) – a sleek, modern reader built for tech enthusiasts. Stay on top of everything in tech, coding, and AI with push notifications, summaries, bookmarks, powerful search, and more – all from your iPhone or Apple Watch.
	•	Sleek Design: Enjoy a clean, beautiful interface that keeps the focus on content
	•	Real-Time Alerts: Get push notifications for top HN stories, so you never miss the hottest news in tech
	•	AI-Powered Summaries: Quickly grasp the essence of articles with concise AI-generated summaries, ensuring you never miss critical insights
	•	Bookmarks: Save your favorite posts to read later and catch up at your own pace
	•	Powerful Search: Instantly find any story or comment – whether it’s about coding, AI, or any other tech topic
	•	Infinite scrolling – read to your heart's content
	•	All-New Home Screen: Flip through posts one by one in a gorgeous full-screen feed with smooth haptic feedback on every swipe (on both iPhone and Apple Watch)
	•	Apple Watch Support: Catch up on Hacker News from your wrist – browse top stories and get alerts on your Apple Watch

Don’t miss out on the future of tech – download now and join the Hacker News community on the go!

Privacy policy can be found here: https://github.com/zumistudios/hazumi-pub/blob/main/privacy-policy.md
EULA (end-user license agreement) can be found here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made Hazumi, a modern HN reader for iOS

quotes.text:
Does anyone here use Hazumi for HN? I’m looking for new features to add and would love your feedback.

https://apps.apple.com/ie/app/hazumi-for-hacker-news/id1670237209

Hello HN,

I'm thrilled to announce the launch of my first app, Hazumi, a Hacker News reader, available for free on iOS!

I’ve been lurking on HN for around 2 years while working on this project seeing people post amazing HN reader apps of their own. I’ve always figured Hazumi wasn’t good enough yet to post here but if I wait around until I’m ready, I’ll probably never share so here goes…

Hazumi is a modern Hacker News app for your pocket with some intentional limitations.

Stories are displayed on a simple colourful card, with images, that condenses all the information you need at a glance. Out of the box you get accessibility features for system settings like light/dark mode and text size. Others are controlled in app for opening stories in a Web View vs externally via Safari, defaulting to Reader Mode and reducing animation bounciness.

You can browse top, new and best sections, limited to 30 stories each, which refresh every hour on the server. I’m not a fan of infinite scrolling or spending a lot of time reading news. I just want to get in and get out while keeping up on the latest.

Other notable features:
- Basic search
- Widgets for your Home and Lock Screen
- Apple Watch app 
- Warns you of non-HTTPS links

There are a few “PRO” features that require a subscription ($/€1.99 monthly):
- AI summaries of comments on stories that have at least 30 root level comments
- In app newsletter (yesterday’s top 10 stories)
- Bookmarking with iCloud support

quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Do we have an App for Hacker News?

quotes.text:
Hey HN!

I'm James, a solo dev working on Hazumi, a Hacker News reader for iOS and web. It's hard to believe it has been around 10 months since I launched my app here on HN.

I'm happy to announce that keyword based Push Notifications are now available. It has quickly become my favourite feature as I've been developing and testing it these past few weeks. Widgets still have a place in my heart though.

It has been super neat to follow the Apple and Epic saga and various programming languages through notifications as soon as they're posted.

Essentially, there are a list of keywords you can subscribe to, and when they appear in the title of a post on Hacker News, you'll get notified immediately. I'm adding more keywords to that list as time goes on. I'm happy to add your suggestions too.

It's worth noting that the app does cost $/€1 to download and it also requires a subscription of $/€1 per month for push notifications. However, there is a free trial for new users. Your financial support really helps me afford the server, database, AI summaries, and now Push Notifications.

As always, I welcome everyone's feedback and feature requests.

Web version is here: https://www.hazumi.news

Cheers HN!
James

There are a good few web and mobile apps out there to help you filter through what you want to read.

I'm rebuilding my website over at https://dev.hazumi.news which will soon let you search and filter by categories assigned by AI, e.g. posts by tech news, programming, business, economics, etc.

The iOS version today already has keyword based push notifications (with pro subscription), so you can toggle on notifications for specific keywords like Ruby, Rust, Apple, Google, etc from a predefined list, that I can add to if you request it.

Here's the app if you're interested: https://apps.apple.com/ie/app/hazumi-news/id1670237209
